cues.en: Instructor: Now we're going to explore the correlation coefficient and the covariance in code.
cues.zh: 講師：現在透過程式碼，探索相關係數與共變異數。

cues.en: And you will see several different formulas that allow us to compute these two quantities.
cues.zh: 你會看到幾種不同的公式，都能計算這兩個量。

cues.en: Okay, so we start by simulating some correlated data.
cues.zh: 首先模擬一些相關的資料。

cues.en: This is a pretty easy way to generate simulated data.
cues.zh: 這是產生模擬資料的一種相當簡單的方法。

cues.en: So you just come up with one variable, and that can be whatever it you want it to be, it doesn't really matter, and then you set some other variable to be that first variable plus random noise.
cues.zh: 先建立一個變數，它可以是任何你想要的內容，沒有關係；再把另一個變數設為第一個變數加上隨機雜訊。

cues.en: And as long as the noise isn't so overwhelming, then you're going to generate correlated data.
cues.zh: 只要雜訊沒有大到完全壓過訊號，就能產生相關的資料。

cues.en: So let's see.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: Here, we see what this data look like.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到資料的樣子。

cues.en: Pretty respectable correlation here.
cues.zh: 有相當不錯的相關。

cues.en: You can see that as I increase the amount of noise here, then the correlation is gonna go away.
cues.zh: 可以看到，當我增加這裡的雜訊量，相關就會消失。

cues.en: Likewise, if I decrease the amount of noise, then the correlation gets tighter.
cues.zh: 反過來，減少雜訊，相關就會更加緊密。

cues.en: Now, this is a decent way to create correlated noise, but it's not really the best method, because you can't really control
cues.zh: 這是建立相關雜訊的可行方法，但並不是最好的方法，因為無法真正控制

cues.en: the exact correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 確切的相關係數。

cues.en: It would be nice if we could say, we want two variables to be correlated at 0.4, so now generate those data with a correlation of 0.4.
cues.zh: 如果能直接說，我要兩個變數的相關為 0.4，然後就產生相關為 0.4 的資料，那就好了。

cues.en: In fact, that's what we're going to do in the next video.
cues.zh: 事實上，下一支影片就要做這件事。

cues.en: We're going to, I will show you how to compute data, variables with a specified correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 我會示範如何產生具有指定相關係數的資料與變數。

cues.en: Anyway, these are the data that we are going to be working with here.
cues.zh: 總之，這就是我們在這裡要使用的資料。

cues.en: Okay, so we're gonna start by computing the covariance between these two variables.
cues.zh: 先計算兩個變數之間的共變異數。

cues.en: Now I'm gonna show you several different methods, and you have learned by this point in the course that I like to set things up this way.
cues.zh: 我會示範幾種方法；上課到現在，你已經知道我喜歡用這種安排。

cues.en: So for educational purposes, I like to write out all of the formulas in this like painful long code with for loops, and a lot of lines of code,
cues.zh: 基於教學目的，我喜歡把所有公式寫成這種冗長到令人痛苦的程式碼，使用 for 迴圈與許多行程式碼，

cues.en: and all sorts of things, but you'll see that a good way to do it is actually just using a MATLAB function here.
cues.zh: 還有各式各樣的東西。不過你會看到，實際上直接使用 MATLAB 函式就很好。

cues.en: So I'm actually gonna compute covariance in three different ways, and you'll see that they all produce exactly the same results.
cues.zh: 我要用三種不同方法計算共變異數，你會看到結果完全相同。

cues.en: Okay, so here is the first method, and I call this the loop method, because we use a for loop here.
cues.zh: 第一種方法稱為迴圈法，因為這裡用了 for 迴圈。

cues.en: So we are looping over N data points, we have N data points here, and I'm saying that the covariance, which is initialized to zero, the covariance equals itself
cues.zh: 對 N 個資料點逐一迴圈，這裡有 N 個資料點。共變異數一開始設為 0，再把共變異數設為它自己，

cues.en: plus each data point in x minus the mean times each corresponding data point in y minus its mean.
cues.zh: 加上 X 的各資料點減去平均值，乘以 Y 中對應資料點減去其平均值。

cues.en: So this is literally just the formula that I showed in the slides in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這就是上一支影片投影片中展示的公式。

cues.en: Well, okay, not literally, we also need this normalization, divide by N minus one.
cues.zh: 好，也不是完全如此，還需要這個正規化，也就是除以 N 減 1。

cues.en: So the covariance between these two variables turns out to be 1.0310, whatever that means.
cues.zh: 這兩個變數的共變異數是 1.0310，無論這個數字代表什麼。

cues.en: Okay, so now I'm gonna show you method two, which I call the linear algebra method.
cues.zh: 接著示範第二種，我稱為線性代數法。

cues.en: So I'm going to first center these two variables, so yCent and xCent, and that's just the variable minus its mean.
cues.zh: 首先對兩個變數中心化，得到 yCent 與 xCent，就是變數減去自己的平均值。

cues.en: And then I'm computing the dot product between them, and then scaling by N minus one.
cues.zh: 再計算兩者的內積，並用 N 減 1 縮放。

cues.en: And as I mentioned in the previous video, the dot product in linear algebra is defined as elementwise multiplication, and then sum.
cues.zh: 上一支影片提過，線性代數中的內積定義為逐元素相乘，再把結果加總。

cues.en: And here, I'm using a trick in linear algebra, where we can represent the first variable as a row vector and the second as a column vector,
cues.zh: 這裡使用線性代數的一個技巧：第一個變數表示成列向量，第二個表示成欄向量，

cues.en: and then just multiply them, and that gives us the dot product or the inner product.
cues.zh: 接著直接相乘，就得到點積，也就是內積。

cues.en: If you're not familiar with all these terms that I'm saying and what this means, then don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果你不熟悉這些用語與意思，不用擔心。

cues.en: It's just a little bit of linear algebra explanations, and you don't need to know those explanations for the rest of the course.
cues.zh: 這只是一些線性代數說明，後續課程不需要知道這些說明。

cues.en: Okay, and then finally, covariance three is using the MATLAB function cov.
cues.zh: 最後，第三種共變異數方法使用 MATLAB 的 cov 函式。

cues.en: And then I'm inputting one variable here.
cues.zh: 這裡輸入一個變數。

cues.en: So I'm actually only inputting one thing, but this is actually a matrix with two columns, where the first column is x, and the second column is y.
cues.zh: 雖然只輸入一個東西，但它其實是有兩欄的矩陣，第一欄是 X，第二欄是 Y。

cues.en: So now let's compare these things.
cues.zh: 現在比較這些結果。

cues.en: So we have covar, let's see, I'll write these out here.
cues.zh: 我們有 covar，看看，我把它們寫在這裡。

cues.en: covar1 is 1.0310.
cues.zh: covar1 是 1.0310。

cues.en: covar2 is, oops, I didn't run this code.
cues.zh: covar2 是——哎呀，我還沒執行這段程式碼。

cues.en: covar, let's see, I'll dump out covar1 again.
cues.zh: covar，看看，再把 covar1 輸出一次。

cues.en: So covar1 is 1.0310.
cues.zh: covar1 是 1.0310。

cues.en: covar2 is exactly the same value, even though it looks like we did something very different here.
cues.zh: covar2 的值完全相同，雖然這裡看起來做了很不一樣的事。

cues.en: This is actually just a different way of writing out this stuff here.
cues.zh: 其實只是把這些運算換一種寫法。

cues.en: And then covar3, that should also be the same thing.
cues.zh: covar3 應該也相同。

cues.en: Of course, I didn't run this yet, so covar3, and hmm, wow, I was expecting a single number, but in fact, we got a matrix of numbers.
cues.zh: 當然，這段還沒執行。covar3，哇，我原本預期只有一個數字，結果得到數字矩陣。

cues.en: We got a two by two grid of numbers.
cues.zh: 得到一個 2 乘 2 的數字方格。

cues.en: Now, it looks like this number here and this number here correspond to exactly the covariances that we computed up here.
cues.zh: 這個數字與這個數字，看起來都精確對應上面計算的共變異數。

cues.en: And what is going on with these things?
cues.zh: 其他這些數字是怎麼回事？

cues.en: Well, these two numbers turn out to be the variances of each variable.
cues.zh: 這兩個數字其實是各個變數的變異數。

cues.en: This is called a covariance matrix.
cues.zh: 這叫作共變異數矩陣。

cues.en: It's two by two because we inputted a two column vector, or matrix.
cues.zh: 它是 2 乘 2，因為輸入的是兩欄的向量，或者說矩陣。

cues.en: Now I'm going to talk more about why this comes out as a matrix and what that means, how to interpret a covariance matrix in,
cues.zh: 至於為什麼輸出矩陣、那是什麼意思，以及如何解讀共變異數矩陣，

cues.en: well, the next lecture video.
cues.zh: 下一支講授影片會進一步說明。

cues.en: So I think it's in two videos from now.
cues.zh: 我想應該是再過兩支影片。

cues.en: Anyway, so three different ways to compute a covariance matrix.
cues.zh: 總之，這是計算共變異數矩陣的三種方法。

cues.en: And needless to say, the simplest, most straightforward way is using the MATLAB cov function, but this method is also useful in some cases,
cues.zh: 不用說，最簡單、最直接的方法是 MATLAB 的 cov 函式，但這個方法在某些情況下也有用，

cues.en: and this is probably never useful, this is just for teaching purposes here.
cues.zh: 而這一個大概永遠用不到，這裡純粹是為了教學。

cues.en: Okay, now let's move to correlation.
cues.zh: 現在來看相關。

cues.en: Again, I'm going to show you this using the long method.
cues.zh: 同樣先示範冗長的方法。

cues.en: And then of course, in practice, you would just use it with the corr function.
cues.zh: 當然，實際上只要使用 corr 函式。

cues.en: There's also a corrcoef function.
cues.zh: 另外也有 corrcoef 函式。

cues.en: Okay, so here, I'm computing the numerator.
cues.zh: 這裡計算分子。

cues.en: So this is the sum of all of the data points elementwise multiplied and subtracted from the mean.
cues.zh: 也就是對所有資料點減去平均值、逐元素相乘之後加總。

cues.en: And then here, I compute the denominator.
cues.zh: 接著計算分母。

cues.en: And again, if you are confused about this code here, you can refer back to your notes from the previous video and check that this code
cues.zh: 如果對這裡的程式碼感到困惑，可以回去參考上一支影片的筆記，確認這段程式碼

cues.en: is just an implementation of the formula that I showed.
cues.zh: 就是先前展示的公式實作。

cues.en: And then here, we have the correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 這裡得到相關係數。

cues.en: It's the numerator divided by the square root of the, of what I gave here as the denominator.
cues.zh: 就是分子除以這裡稱為分母的量的平方根。

cues.en: Okay, so let's see.
cues.zh: 好，看看。

cues.en: The correlation between these two variables is 0.7408, and using the MATLAB function corr, we get also a matrix, huh, look at that.
cues.zh: 這兩個變數的相關是 0.7408。使用 MATLAB 的 corr 函式，也得到一個矩陣，看看。

cues.en: And now, this is also interesting, we get ones on the diagonal.
cues.zh: 這也很有意思，對角線上都是 1。

cues.en: So these two elements are one, and these two elements show the correlation between x and y.
cues.zh: 這兩個元素是 1，另外兩個元素表示 X 與 Y 之間的相關。

cues.en: Again, if that seems a little weird, if you're not familiar with looking at correlation matrices, then don't worry, that's the entire video in a couple of videos is all about correlation matrices.
cues.zh: 如果覺得有點奇怪，不熟悉相關矩陣，不用擔心；再過幾支影片，整支影片都會介紹相關矩陣。

cues.en: Okay, so now I want to just show you another way of relating a correlation, or computing a correlation from a covariance.
cues.zh: 現在示範另一種把相關與共變異數連結起來，或從共變異數計算相關的方法。

cues.en: What I'm going to do here is actually compute the covariance.
cues.zh: 這裡其實要計算共變異數。

cues.en: Notice this is a vector, so it's x transpose times y divided by N minus one.
cues.zh: 注意這是向量，所以是 X 轉置乘以 Y，再除以 N 減 1。

cues.en: That is exactly how I computed the covariance here.
cues.zh: 這和這裡計算共變異數的方式完全相同。

cues.en: This was not the correlation, this was the covariance, but I wanna show you that you can also compute the correlation as normalized covariance.
cues.zh: 這不是相關，而是共變異數；但我要示範，相關也可以計算成經過正規化的共變異數。

cues.en: So you can compute the zscore, I'm calling this xn for normalized, so the zscore of x and the zscore of y.
cues.zh: 先計算 zscore，這裡稱為 xn，n 表示正規化，也就是 X 的 Z 分數與 Y 的 Z 分數。

cues.en: And when your variables are normalized to have a mean of zero and a standard deviation of one, then the covariance turns out to be
cues.zh: 當變數經過正規化，平均值為 0、標準差為 1 時，共變異數就會

cues.en: exactly the same thing as the correlation.
cues.zh: 與相關完全相同。

cues.en: That's pretty interesting to think about.
cues.zh: 這個想法很有意思。

cues.en: And in the next video on correlation matrices, in the slides, you will see why that is the case.
cues.zh: 下一支介紹相關矩陣的影片中，投影片會說明原因。

cues.en: You will see why it happens that when you normalize the data to have a variance of one, that the correlation and covariance
cues.zh: 你會看到，當資料正規化成變異數為 1 時，為什麼相關與共變異數

cues.en: are exactly the same quantity.
cues.zh: 會是完全相同的量。

cues.en: Okay, anyway, I didn't actually run this to you yet and show it.
cues.zh: 總之，還沒有實際執行來示範。

cues.en: So we have corr3 equals 0.7408, which is what we got with these other methods up here.
cues.zh: 得到 corr3 等於 0.7408，與上面其他方法得到的值相同。

cues.en: Okay, so in the previous video, I also talked about the statistical significances of the correlation coefficient, and I told you that it was dependent
cues.zh: 上一支影片也談了相關係數的統計顯著性，我提到它同時取決於

cues.en: both on the magnitude of the correlation and also on the sample size, so on r and on n.
cues.zh: 相關的大小與樣本大小，也就是 r 與 N。

cues.en: What I'm going to do here is create a two-dimensional space of, it's gonna be a t-value space that's based on separately varying r and n.
cues.zh: 這裡我要建立一個二維空間，也就是分別改變 r 與 N 所得到的 t 值空間。

cues.en: So here, I'm defining the correlation coefficient to go from minus one to plus one, and the sample size to go from 5 to 200.
cues.zh: 這裡定義相關係數從負 1 到正 1，樣本大小從 5 到 200。

cues.en: Okay, so then I loop over the different r values, loop over the different n values, and here, you see, so notice, we're not actually creating data and correlating them here,
cues.zh: 接著對不同 r 值迴圈，再對不同 N 值迴圈。注意，我們並沒有真的建立資料，再計算它們的相關，

cues.en: because I don't actually care about the data, I care about the t-statistic and its statistical significance, its associated p-value.
cues.zh: 因為我不關心實際資料，而是關心 t 統計量，以及它的統計顯著性，也就是對應的 P 值。

cues.en: So we don't actually need data, because I'm just specifying this variable r immediately.
cues.zh: 所以不需要資料，直接指定變數 r 就好。

cues.en: So here was the numerator of the formula for the t-statistic.
cues.zh: 這是 t 統計量公式的分子。

cues.en: It was r times the square root of n minus two, and the denominator was one minus r squared.
cues.zh: 是 r 乘上 N 減 2 的平方根，分母則是 1 減 r 平方。

cues.en: So pretty straightforward implementation of that formula.
cues.zh: 相當直接地實作了這個公式。

cues.en: So here's the t-value stored in tmatrix, and the p-value, I'm just implementing this as the t-statistic,
cues.zh: t 值儲存在 tmatrix，而 P 值這裡也是以 t 統計量來實作，

cues.en: so exactly what I'm computing here is also present here.
cues.zh: 也就是這裡的計算，在這裡也出現了一次。

cues.en: And here, I'm just taking the absolute value because we want the the p-value of the effect size in general, we don't really care about whether it's positive or negative.
cues.zh: 這裡取絕對值，因為我們想知道的是整體效果大小的 P 值，不特別關心正負。

cues.en: So n minus two degrees of freedom to evaluate this t-statistic on the t-distribution to get us our p-value.
cues.zh: 用 N 減 2 個自由度，在 t 分布上評估這個 t 統計量，取得 P 值。

cues.en: So I'm sure you are super duper curious to see what this thing looks like.
cues.zh: 相信你一定非常好奇結果長什麼樣子。

cues.en: I was too, when I was programming this, I was very excited.
cues.zh: 我寫程式時也一樣，非常興奮。

cues.en: I spent so much time writing this code, I got really excited, so you can see how excited I was here.
cues.zh: 花了很多時間寫這段程式碼，真的很興奮，從這裡可以看出我的興奮程度。

cues.en: Okay, so here, I'm gonna make an image.
cues.zh: 這裡要建立一張影像。

cues.en: Ah, let me just show it so we can look at it.
cues.zh: 先顯示出來看看。

cues.en: Okay, so here is what it looks like.
cues.zh: 結果是這樣。

cues.en: So these are, this is a matrix of t-values.
cues.zh: 這是一個 t 值矩陣。

cues.en: So every pixel in this matrix corresponds to that t-value that I showed in the slides, and that shows the statistical significance
cues.zh: 矩陣的每個像素，都對應投影片中展示的 t 值，表示相關的統計顯著性，

cues.en: of the correlation based on r, the correlation coefficient, and based on the sample size n.
cues.zh: 它取決於相關係數 r，以及樣本大小 N。

cues.en: So it's pretty interesting to see that the correlation, and then this black line corresponds to p less than 0.05.
cues.zh: 這很有意思，而這條黑線對應 P 小於 0.05。

cues.en: So anything below the black line here and above the black line here would be statistically significant at p less than 0.05,
cues.zh: 這裡黑線以下，以及這邊黑線以上的區域，都是 P 小於 0.05 的統計顯著結果，

cues.en: so an alpha threshold of 5%.
cues.zh: 也就是 alpha 門檻為 5%。

cues.en: And anything in between these two lines would not be considered statistically significant.
cues.zh: 介於兩條線之間的區域，則不視為統計顯著。

cues.en: And so what's interesting is that you can see that for even a modest correlation, it's going to become significant.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，即使相關強度普通，仍然會變得顯著。

cues.en: So here, the correlation coefficient, which means the strength of the linear relationship between the two variables, is not changing here in this row.
cues.zh: 這一列中，相關係數，也就是兩個變數之間的線性關係強度，並沒有改變。

cues.en: It's staying exactly the same, but we are increasing our sample size, so the t-value is getting more and more negative, the magnitude's getting larger and larger,
cues.zh: 它完全相同，但我們增加樣本大小，所以 t 值愈來愈負，絕對值愈來愈大，

cues.en: so we're getting a more and more significant result, even though the strength of the relationship is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 結果也就愈來愈顯著，即使關係強度完全相同。

cues.en: Okay, so this is pretty interesting to see.
cues.zh: 看到這個很有意思。

cues.en: Alright, so just one final note.
cues.zh: 最後補充一點。

cues.en: You don't actually have to compute the t-value separately like this, and the p-value like this.
cues.zh: 其實不必像這樣另外計算 t 值，以及這樣計算 P 值。

cues.en: Of course, you can if you want to.
cues.zh: 當然，你想這樣做也可以。

cues.en: If this gives you like a warm fuzzy feeling, then go for it.
cues.zh: 如果這讓你覺得心滿意足，就去做吧。

cues.en: But you can also just use the MATLAB function corr.
cues.zh: 不過，也可以直接使用 MATLAB 的 corr 函式。

cues.en: The way that I'm going to correlate or generate correlated data here is by first generating one variable, and this can be anything you want.
cues.zh: 這裡建立相關資料的方式，是先產生一個變數，內容可以任意。

cues.en: It doesn't have to be normally distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 不必是常態分布的隨機數。

cues.en: You generate these, you generate x however you want, and then you set y to be equal to x plus a little bit of random noise, and that is a guaranteed, tried and true method
cues.zh: 用任何方式產生 X，再將 Y 設為 X 加上一點隨機雜訊，這是一種可靠、經過驗證的方法，

cues.en: to simulate correlated data.
cues.zh: 用來模擬相關的資料。

cues.en: So here, you see pretty clear that there's a moderate, decent correlation between these two variables.
cues.zh: 這裡很清楚，兩個變數有中等、還不錯的相關。

cues.en: Now, one limitation of this method is that it's difficult to control the exact correlation between the two variables.
cues.zh: 不過，這個方法的限制是，難以控制兩個變數確切的相關。

cues.zh: 例如，我想要變數的相關為 0.3。

cues.zh: 一直調整這兩行程式碼，直到碰巧得到 0.3 的相關，並不太可行。

cues.en: You can see that as I make the noise larger, so I increase the amplitude of the noise, the correlation is decreasing.

cues.en: These data look, well, they still look a little bit correlated maybe, but seems to be certainly a lot weaker.

cues.en: And of course, in contrast, we could decrease the amount of noise, and therefore increase the level of correlation here.
cues.zh: 反過來，當然也可以減少雜訊量，讓相關程度提高。

cues.en: Now, in the next video, I'm going to show you how to simulate two variables that are correlated according to a coefficient that you can specify.

cues.en: That's really useful for simulating data.

cues.en: Nonetheless, for this video, this will suffice.
cues.zh: 不過這支影片用這個方法就足夠。

cues.en: Okay, so what we're going to do now is compute the covariance between these two variables, x and y.
cues.zh: 現在要計算 X 與 Y 這兩個變數的共變異數。

cues.zh: 不過你已經知道，我喜歡用詳盡展開的程式方法教學，因為剛開始學習時，看見所有步驟

cues.en: And then, of course, once you understand that, and you move to applications, you're done with your learning, and you move to more applied stuff, then you probably just wanna stick to
cues.zh: 當然，等你理解之後，進入應用階段，不再是學習，而是處理實務內容時，大概就會想使用

cues.en: the easier methods like this.
cues.zh: 這種比較簡單的方法。

cues.en: Okay, so here is the first method, I call this the loop method.
cues.zh: 第一種稱為迴圈法。

cues.en: This is actually the most direct implementation of the formula that I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 這其實是投影片中公式最直接的實作。

cues.en: So we loop over our N variables, our N data points in each variable, and we set this variable covar1,
cues.zh: 對 N 個變數——也就是每個變數中的 N 個資料點——迴圈，再把 covar1，

cues.en: which I've initialized to be zero, to be itself plus x, so the ith element in x minus the mean of x
cues.zh: 也就是先初始化為 0 的變數，設為它自己，加上 X 的第 i 個元素減去 X 平均值，

cues.en: times the ith element of y minus the mean of y.
cues.zh: 乘以 Y 的第 i 個元素減去 Y 平均值。

cues.en: And then we have to normalize by dividing by N minus one, and this is essentially the formula that I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 再除以 N 減 1 來正規化，基本上就是投影片中展示的公式。

cues.en: Okay, then I'm implementing what I call the linear algebra method.
cues.zh: 接著實作我稱為線性代數法的方法。

cues.en: So here, I'm generating a new variable, xCent and yCent.
cues.zh: 這裡建立新變數 xCent 與 yCent。

cues.en: That is the centered version or mean subtracted version of x and y.
cues.zh: 它們是 X 與 Y 的中心化版本，也就是減去平均值的版本。

cues.en: Then I'm using the NumPy .dot function to compute the dot product between X and Y.
cues.zh: 再使用 NumPy 的 .dot 函式，計算 X 與 Y 的內積。

cues.en: So I mentioned in the previous video that the dot product is defined as the sum of element y's multiplications, which is really what we're doing here.
cues.zh: 上一支影片提過，內積的定義是逐元素相乘再加總，也就是我們在這裡做的事。

cues.en: So if this seems weird, and confusing, and you don't really get what's going on here, then don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果覺得奇怪、困惑，不太懂這裡在做什麼，不用擔心。

cues.en: This is just for the people who have some background with linear algebra.
cues.zh: 這只是給有一些線性代數背景的人看的。

cues.en: You don't need to understand this dot product thing to survive in the rest of this statistics course.
cues.zh: 要繼續學完這門統計課，不一定需要理解這個內積概念。

cues.en: Okay, and then, of course, we have the one-liner method.
cues.zh: 當然，也有只需要一行的方法。

cues.en: And the way that I'm actually doing this is by stacking these vectors into a matrix.
cues.zh: 這裡的實作方式是把這些向量堆疊成矩陣。

cues.en: So what I'm inputting into the cov function is actually a matrix that has two columns.
cues.zh: 所以輸入 cov 函式的，其實是有兩欄的矩陣。

cues.en: The first column is x, and the second column is y.
cues.zh: 第一欄是 X，第二欄是 Y。

cues.en: Okay, and then I'm just gonna print out these three methods for getting the covariance matrix, and we should see that they're the same.
cues.zh: 接著印出用這三種方法得到的共變異數矩陣，應該會看到它們相同。

cues.en: Actually, I think it's gonna be a little easier if I print these out on different lines like this.
cues.zh: 其實分成不同行印出來，可能比較容易看。

cues.en: What am I missing, okay.
cues.zh: 漏了什麼？好。

cues.en: Right, so here, we see covar1, covar2, they are exactly identical, they're totally equal to each other.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到，covar1 與 covar2 完全一致，彼此完全相等。

cues.en: Huh, but what is going on here?
cues.zh: 但這裡是怎麼回事？

cues.en: It looks like covar3, the output of the cov function, is not a single number, it's a matrix, it's a two by two matrix.
cues.zh: covar3，也就是 cov 函式的輸出，看起來不是單一數字，而是矩陣，是 2 乘 2 矩陣。

cues.en: And it turns out that this number is exactly the same as this number, which is the same as the covariance.
cues.zh: 這個數字與這個數字完全相同，也就是共變異數。

cues.en: And these numbers here on the diagonal elements of this matrix are something else.
cues.zh: 矩陣對角線上的這些數字則是別的東西。

cues.en: So it turns out that those are the variances of each variable, x and y, and these off-diagonal elements are the covariance between x and y.
cues.zh: 它們是 X 與 Y 各自的變異數，而非對角線元素則是 X 與 Y 的共變異數。

cues.en: Now, I'm going to talk more about covariance matrices, it gets its own lecture in, I think it's in two videos from now.
cues.zh: 共變異數矩陣會有自己的講授影片，應該再過兩支影片就會詳細說明。

cues.en: So if this seems a little bit weird, then don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果覺得有點奇怪，不用擔心。

cues.en: It's supposed to look like this, and you will learn why very soon.
cues.zh: 它本來就應該長這樣，你很快會知道原因。

cues.en: Alright, so that was all about covariance.
cues.zh: 以上是共變異數。

cues.en: Now we are going to compute the correlation, and just as I mentioned above, exactly the same.
cues.zh: 現在計算相關，同樣如前面所說。

cues.en: I'm going to show you now this like long method, but in practice, you can just use the corrcoef function.
cues.zh: 先示範這種冗長的方法，但實際上只要使用 corrcoef 函式。

cues.en: MATLAB, you can see I copied this code from MATLAB, the Python method.
cues.zh: MATLAB——你可以看到，這段 Python 方法是從 MATLAB 程式碼複製過來的。

cues.en: Okay, so we have the numerator.
cues.zh: 這裡是分子。

cues.en: So this is the elementwise sum of the variables with their means removed.
cues.zh: 也就是將變數減去平均值後，逐元素運算再加總。

cues.en: And then I have the denominator, which is same concept but squared, and then all of the elements minus the mean squared,
cues.zh: 接著是分母，概念相同，但使用平方，也就是各元素減去平均值後平方，

cues.en: and then the square root of that.
cues.zh: 最後開平方根。

cues.en: So we expect corr1 and corr2 to be the same.
cues.zh: 我們預期 corr1 與 corr2 相同。

cues.en: And here, okay, again, the output looks a little bit confusing, so let me do this.
cues.zh: 不過輸出看起來又有點混亂，所以改成這樣。

cues.en: And here, you see a similar kind of weird thing as we did with the covariance.
cues.zh: 這裡看到與共變異數類似的奇怪情況。

cues.en: So we get the correlation from our long method here, and it looks like the off-diagonal elements on this matrix
cues.zh: 用這種冗長方法得到相關，而矩陣的非對角線元素，看起來

cues.en: are exactly the same as the correlation, and the diagonal elements are one.
cues.zh: 與相關完全相同，對角線元素則是 1。

cues.en: Again, I will talk more about this in a few videos from now, but briefly, this is the correlation of each variable with itself, so of course, that's going to be one.
cues.zh: 之後幾支影片會詳談。簡單說，這是每個變數與自己的相關，當然會是 1。

cues.en: So there's a third method for computing the correlation coefficient that I want to illustrate to you here.
cues.zh: 這裡還想示範第三種計算相關係數的方法。

cues.en: And that is that you can compute the covariance between two variables, and if those variables are normalized
cues.zh: 你可以計算兩個變數的共變異數；如果變數經過正規化，

cues.en: such that they have a mean of zero and a variance of one, then the correlation coefficient is exactly equal to the covariance.
cues.zh: 使平均值為 0、變異數為 1，那麼相關係數就精確等於共變異數。

cues.en: And so to illustrate that to you, I'm applying this linear algebra formula that I showed you above to compute the covariance.
cues.zh: 為了示範，我套用上面介紹的線性代數公式，計算共變異數。

cues.en: So I'm not computing the correlation between x and y, I'm computing the covariance between x and y.
cues.zh: 所以算的不是 X 與 Y 的相關，而是 X 與 Y 的共變異數。

cues.en: And let me first get rid of this.
cues.zh: 先把這個去掉。

cues.en: And we can run this, and you can see that this number is now much closer to the correlation than it was to the covariance.
cues.zh: 執行之後可以看到，這個數字現在更接近相關，而不是先前的共變異數。

cues.en: The covariance was 0.91, and the correlation is 0.668.
cues.zh: 共變異數是 0.91，相關是 0.668。

cues.en: And here we get a, well, it's, I don't know if I can call this a correlation, almost a correlation of 0.67.
cues.zh: 這裡得到——我不知道能不能稱為相關——大約是 0.67。

cues.en: It's pretty close to what we got here.
cues.zh: 與這裡的結果相當接近。

cues.en: Now, obviously, you already know what the story is here, why this is slightly different.
cues.zh: 你顯然已經知道，這裡為什麼會有些微差異。

cues.en: I'm gonna say denominator degrees of freedom equals 1, ddof=1, compute this again, and then we get the same correlation,
cues.zh: 我把分母自由度設為 1，也就是 ddof=1，再計算一次，就得到相同的相關，

cues.en: or I should call this now covariance.
cues.zh: 或者現在應該稱為共變異數。

cues.en: This is the covariance that I'm actually computing.
cues.zh: 我實際計算的就是共變異數。

cues.en: But you can see it's exactly equal to correlation.
cues.zh: 但可以看到，它與相關完全相等。

cues.en: It looks like they differ on the very last number here.
cues.zh: 看起來只有最後一位數不同。

cues.en: That's a tiny, tiny difference.
cues.zh: 那是非常微小的差異。

cues.en: We can just chalk that off to computer precision, some rounding errors.
cues.zh: 可以歸因於電腦精度與一些四捨五入誤差。

cues.en: Okay, so the conclusion here is that if your data are already zscored, all the variables are appropriately zscored,
cues.zh: 因此，結論是，如果資料已經轉為 Z 分數，所有變數都適當地轉成 Z 分數，

cues.en: then covariance and correlation are exactly the same thing.
cues.zh: 共變異數與相關就完全相同。

cues.en: Now, that may seem like a weird concept, but in the video on correlation matrix, I'm going to discuss the normalization term
cues.zh: 這個概念可能有點奇怪，但在相關矩陣的影片中，我會更詳細討論相關係數的

cues.en: for the correlation coefficient in more detail.
cues.zh: 正規化項。

cues.en: And when you're looking at that slide, I would like you to think about what happens to the correlation coefficient formula when the variance of a variable,
cues.zh: 看到那張投影片時，希望你想想：當一個變數的變異數，

cues.en: of both variables are set to be one.
cues.zh: 也就是兩個變數的變異數，都設為 1，相關係數公式會變成什麼樣子。

cues.en: Okay, so that's enough about correlation and covariance.
cues.zh: 相關與共變異數就談到這裡。

cues.en: What I want to do now is explore the statistical significances of the correlation coefficients.
cues.zh: 接著要探索相關係數的統計顯著性。

cues.en: And we're going to do this by creating a two-dimensional space, a 2D map, an image of t-values
cues.zh: 方法是建立二維空間，也就是二維地圖，一張 t 值影像，

cues.en: based on correlation magnitudes and sample sizes.
cues.zh: 依據相關大小與樣本大小來建立。

cues.en: So remember, I showed the formula for statistical significance in the previous video, and that formula was for a t-statistic, and is based on r, and it's based on n.
cues.zh: 還記得上一支影片展示的統計顯著性公式，它用於 t 統計量，取決於 r，也取決於 N。

cues.en: So what we're gonna do here is systematically vary r, and also independently, systematically vary n, and recompute t, and also compute the corresponding p-value.
cues.zh: 我們將有系統地改變 r，同時獨立且有系統地改變 N，重新計算 t，並算出對應 P 值。

cues.en: So I'm going to define, r will range from minus one to plus one, n is going to range from 5 to 200, so the number of sample points.
cues.zh: 定義 r 的範圍為負 1 到正 1，N，也就是樣本點數量，從 5 到 200。

cues.en: And then you can see inside this double for loop.
cues.zh: 接著看這個雙層 for 迴圈內部。

cues.en: So we loop over r, we loop over n, and here, what I'm doing is computing the t-value and computing the p-value.
cues.zh: 對 r 迴圈，再對 N 迴圈，這裡計算 t 值，並計算 P 值。

cues.en: Notice we're not actually simulating data, we don't need any data for this simulation.
cues.zh: 注意，我們沒有真的模擬資料，這個模擬不需要任何資料。

cues.en: All we need are the r values and the n values.
cues.zh: 只需要 r 值與 N 值。

cues.en: So this is the numerator of the t-statistic.
cues.zh: 這是 t 統計量的分子。

cues.en: It's r times the square root of n minus two.
cues.zh: 是 r 乘上 N 減 2 的平方根。

cues.en: And the denominator, you will remember from the previous video is one minus r squared.
cues.zh: 分母，記得上一支影片提過，是 1 減 r 平方。

cues.en: So then we have the t-statistic itself, which is just, well, just that ratio.
cues.zh: 接著得到 t 統計量本身，也就是這個比值。

cues.en: And then the p-value is the, so evaluated that p-value at the, in the cumulative density function for the t-statistic
cues.zh: 然後透過 t 統計量的累積密度函數，評估得到 P 值，

cues.en: with n minus two degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 自由度為 N 減 2。

cues.en: And here, I'm just saying the absolute value because I don't need to, I don't want to have to worry about whether this is positive or negative, meaning on the right or the left side of the t-distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡使用絕對值，因為我不想考慮它是正或負，也就是在 t 分布的右側還是左側。

cues.en: Alright, so when I was coding this, I was getting really impatient while coding this, because I was so curious to see what the results look like.
cues.zh: 我寫這段程式時非常等不及，因為很想知道結果長什麼樣子。

cues.en: So let us inspect this image, here we go.
cues.zh: 來檢視這張影像，就是這裡。

cues.en: So again, this is showing a matrix.
cues.zh: 這又是在顯示矩陣。

cues.en: This is the t-values matrix.
cues.zh: 這是 t 值矩陣。

cues.en: And what I varied here is the sample size and the correlation coefficient, so the magnitude of the correlation.
cues.zh: 這裡改變的是樣本大小與相關係數，也就是相關的大小。

cues.en: And what's pretty, sorry, and this black line here corresponds to a p-value of 0.05, so an alpha threshold of 5%.
cues.zh: 有趣的是——抱歉，這條黑線對應 P 值 0.05，也就是 5% 的 alpha 門檻。

cues.en: So anything above this black line here and below this black line down here corresponds to t-values that are statistically significant,
cues.zh: 這邊黑線以上，以及下面這條黑線以下，都對應達到統計顯著的 t 值，

cues.en: so correlation coefficients that we would consider to be statistically significant.
cues.zh: 也就是我們會視為統計顯著的相關係數。

cues.en: By the way, I see now that the color, the matrix is actually flipped here, because the blue values should correspond to negative t-values, negative correlation coefficients,
cues.zh: 順帶一提，現在發現顏色，也就是矩陣，其實上下翻轉了，因為藍色應該對應負的 t 值與負相關係數，

cues.en: and the yellow values should correspond to positive correlation coefficients.
cues.zh: 黃色則應該對應正相關係數。

cues.en: Nonetheless, it doesn't actually change the story, because the correlation is symmetric and the t-values are symmetric.
cues.zh: 但這不影響整體說明，因為相關是對稱的，t 值也是對稱的。

cues.en: Okay, but so what this plot means is that if we have a, like a modest to small correlation coefficient, let's say 0.25, with a small sample size,
cues.zh: 這張圖表示，如果相關係數普通或偏小，例如 0.25，而樣本大小很小，

cues.en: that correlation coefficient is not going to be statistically significant.
cues.zh: 這個相關係數就不會達到統計顯著。

cues.en: But as we add more and more samples, as we add more and more data, that t-statistic, the correlation coefficient becomes highly significant,
cues.zh: 但隨著加入愈來愈多樣本、愈來愈多資料，這個 t 統計量，也就是相關係數，會變得高度顯著，

cues.en: even though the actual strength of the relationship is staying the same.
cues.zh: 即使關係的實際強度保持不變。

cues.en: So we can have the same magnitude, the same linear relationship between variables, and we just throw more and more data into the mix,
cues.zh: 因此，可以保持相同大小、相同的變數線性關係，只是不斷加入更多資料，

cues.en: and that correlation becomes more and more significant, the p-value gets smaller and smaller.
cues.zh: 相關就愈來愈顯著，P 值愈來愈小。

cues.en: So that's pretty interesting to think about.
cues.zh: 這很值得思考。

cues.en: So I have a small question here.
cues.zh: 這裡有個小問題。

cues.en: Why do we get this warning message?
cues.zh: 為什麼會出現這個警告訊息？

cues.en: I'm actually not going to answer the question, because I already answered the question in the previous slide when I talked about the formula for computing the t-statistic,
cues.zh: 我不會回答，因為上一張投影片討論 t 統計量計算公式時，已經回答過了。

cues.en: so I will let you ponder this warning message.
cues.zh: 所以讓你自己思考這個警告訊息。

cues.en: The last thing I want to point out in this video is that here, I computed the p-value manually by evaluating the t-value that I computed manually
cues.zh: 最後要指出的是，這裡手動計算 P 值，是把手動算出的 t 值，

cues.en: using the cumulative density function.
cues.zh: 代入累積密度函數評估。

cues.en: So you can do this if you're feeling particularly nerdy, but it's really not necessary.
cues.zh: 如果你特別熱衷鑽研，當然可以這樣做，但真的沒有必要。

cues.en: It's not really the best way to set up your code here.
cues.zh: 這其實不是安排程式碼的最佳方式。

cues.en: So again, this is one of these things that I like to do this in teaching code.
cues.zh: 這又是我在教學程式碼中喜歡做的事情。

cues.en: So you see that there's, there isn't a lot of magic, or super duper complicated math that's going into this.
cues.zh: 讓你看到，裡面沒有太多魔法，也沒有超級複雜的數學。

cues.en: I guess there's a little bit of complicated math going into this, although it's also not so bad.
cues.zh: 我想，還是有一點複雜數學，不過其實也沒那麼難。

cues.en: So the math itself isn't so complicated.
cues.zh: 所以數學本身並不太複雜。

cues.en: But that said, it's best to use the correlation function.
cues.zh: 話雖如此，最好還是使用相關函式。

cues.en: And in this case, the NumPy correlation function doesn't actually output a p-value.
cues.zh: 這裡 NumPy 的相關函式其實不會輸出 P 值。

cues.en: So we use the stats module from the SciPy toolbox, and then we use pearsonr, and then we get the first output is the correlation coefficient,
cues.zh: 因此使用 SciPy 工具箱中的 stats 模組，再使用 pearsonr。第一個輸出是相關係數，

cues.en: the second output is the p-value.
cues.zh: 第二個輸出是 P 值。

cues.en: So here is the correlation coefficient yet again, and here's the p-value.
cues.zh: 這裡又是相關係數，這是 P 值。

cues.en: It's 8 times 10 to the minus 10.
cues.zh: 它是 8 乘 10 的負 10 次方。

cues.en: So this is a really, really tiny p-value, so there's a wildly significant, statistically significant correlation between x and y.
cues.zh: 這是非常非常小的 P 值，因此 X 與 Y 之間存在極為顯著的統計相關。
